title: Answer: ringdown echoes, a Casimir residual and cross-arena fits can be checked

statements.text: What can be checked is a set of pre-registered tests: echoes in LIGO O4b and O5 ringdowns, the agreement of $\sqrt{z}$ across echoes and black hole evaporation, a residual Casimir torque across a superconducting transition, and one parameter set across gravitational waves, horizon imaging, neutrinos, clocks, cosmology and pulsar timing.

sources.quote: The purpose here is to show that current data can be organised consistently within this construction and to register tests that make the verdict unambiguous.
The programme does not claim a detection.
